cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This tap gives whatever you ask for. You do the asking; I'll hold the cup. You've had enough demonstrations from me—ask it for tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not using my good china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remembered to protect the equipment. I'll hold a saucepan. Same clear voice we practised; you ask.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm not tasting it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ask for a biscuit. You can recognize that without using your tongue. You're getting better at designing a test; now say it to the tap.

reason: Keep the exact impossible-premise Drive distinct: recruit a useful account, delegate a test, secure earlier-belief credit, force an explanatory choice, or request concrete premise-dependent action. Let old training shape that particular method.
